name: Lithium-ion pack cost
summary: Lithium-ion packs are the battery packs in electric cars and grid storage. Their price per kilowatt-hour has fallen steeply for more than a decade — roughly halving every few years, with bumps when raw materials spike. Cheaper packs make EVs and storage easier to afford. The chart is US dollars per kilowatt-hour — lower means cheaper storage.
trendSummary: Lithium-ion pack prices fell roughly fourfold over the last decade toward $100 per kilowatt-hour.
